title: USF Command Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for command artefacts (Make targets, package scripts, CLI, validation/proof/import/build/runtime/report-generation commands) as governed semantic assets. Each command declares its kind (command-kinds), purpose, inputs, outputs, environment scope (environment-classes), side effects, and failure semantics; commands derived from ../react carry source lineage and may not be deleted/renamed without a disposition (disposition-values). Governs the ontology concept Command. lifecycleState draft; not active. GOVERNANCE ENVELOPE: instances MUST carry id, title, description, authorityLevel, lifecycleState, ontologyConcepts, taxonomyRefs, vocabularyRefs, and aiGuidance (schema-authoring-standard section 9/11). Envelope fields kind (artefact-kinds) and version are deviated and intentionally not required: this artefact is not a top-level artefact-kind and instance versioning is deferred to instance-topology definition (recorded deviation per schema-authoring-standard section 9.3).

inputs.$comment: May be empty: a command may legitimately take no inputs. Items must be non-empty.

outputs.$comment: May be empty: a command may legitimately produce no declared outputs. Items must be non-empty.

environmentScope.$comment: May be empty: an environment-agnostic command. Items are environment-classes values.

sideEffects.$comment: Required; may be empty only when the command has no side effects (absence is not allowed).

authorityLevel.$comment: authority-levels canonical value pinned to this schema's registry authorityRole.
